name: Aegrim's Study
summary: Aegrim's Study is a sealed, ancient chamber tucked deep within Old Ironforge beneath the mountain city. Originally belonging to Thane Aegrim Bronzebeard, the quiet retreat is guarded by slumbering mechanical sentinels and strewn with forgotten dwarven relics.

sections.title: The Thane's Hidden Retreat
sections.body: Buried within the cavernous depths of Old Ironforge, Aegrim's Study stands as a solemn testament to the clan's ancestral past. Dedicated to Thane Aegrim of the Bronzebeard clan, the chamber long served as a private redoubt and vault beneath the busy upper rings of the dwarven capital. Like much of Old Ironforge, it has been largely sealed away from public access, guarded by ancient golem sentries that keep vigil alongside the remains of fallen defenders.

aliases: how to get to aegrims study
faq.answer: Aegrim's Study lies in the subterranean depths of Old Ironforge, beneath the main city of Ironforge. Access to this ancient quarter remains restricted to ordinary citizens and travelers.
Thane Aegrim Bronzebeard was an honored nobleman and leader of the Bronzebeard clan. This secluded chamber served as his private study and sanctuary deep within the heart of the mountain.
The chamber is protected by ancient golem guards, mechanical dwarven constructs left behind to watch over the thane's sanctuary long after its abandonment.

angles.text: For dwarves, Old Ironforge and the study of Thane Aegrim Bronzebeard represent the deeper history of their clan before the mountain was carved into its modern halls.
